title: A Field Guide to Today’s Elections

sentences.en: Today, a field guide to the midterMs.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们来一份中期选举实地指南。

sentences.en: Four themes and four races to watch.
sentences.zh: 四个主题，四场值得关注的选战。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, November 6th, election day.
sentences.zh: 今天是 11 月 6 日星期二，选举日。

sentences.en: Polls open in about 24 hours in this huge, high-stakes, midterm election.
sentences.zh: 在这场规模宏大、影响深远的中期选举中，投票站将在约 24 小时后开放。

sentences.en: Democrats are predicting a blue wave.
sentences.zh: 民主党人预测会出现“蓝色浪潮”。

sentences.en: Republicans say that will not happen.
sentences.zh: 共和党人则表示那不会发生。

sentences.en: It is so tight.

sentences.en: This could go either way.
sentences.zh: 胜负难料。

sentences.en: Early voting is way up compared to 2014.
sentences.zh: 与 2014 年相比，提前投票的人数大幅增加。

sentences.en: It has not just the optics, but the tone of a presidential election.
sentences.zh: 这不仅在视觉上，甚至在基调上都像是一场总统大选。

sentences.en: And that's where we are in American politics.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们目前所处的美国政治环境。

sentences.en: Listen, it's neck and neck in about 21 races across the country.
sentences.zh: 听着，全国大约有 21 场选战正处于势均力敌的状态。

sentences.en: Neck and neck.

sentences.en: So it's going to depend on turnout.

sentences.zh: 亚历克斯·伯恩斯，今天就是决战之日。

sentences.en: At long laSt.

sentences.en: How long would you say you've been covering the midterms, if it's quantifiable?
sentences.zh: 如果可以量化的话，你报道中期选举有多久了？

sentences.en: Oh, I would say almost since the end of the last election.
sentences.zh: 哦，我想说几乎是从上届大选结束就开始了。

sentences.en: Not quite two years, but probably 22 months.
sentences.zh: 虽然不到两年，但大概有 22 个月了。

sentences.en: How many elections are actually happening today?
sentences.zh: 今天实际上有多少场选举在进行？

sentences.en: On the federal level, there are 470.
sentences.zh: 在联邦层面，有 470 场。

sentences.en: There are 435 House seats on the ballot and 35 Senate seats.
sentences.zh: 众议院有 435 个席位，参议院有 35 个席位在进行改选。

sentences.en: And then you have countless state and local elections around the country, including 38 really important governor's races.
sentences.zh: 此外，全国各地还有无数的州和地方选举，包括 38 场非常重要的州长竞选。

sentences.en: And remind us of the math that you're going to be watching today.
sentences.zh: 请提醒我们一下，你今天会关注哪些关键数据？

sentences.en: In the House, we're looking at 60 to 70 seats, almost all of them held by Republicans that really could go either way at this point.
sentences.zh: 在众议院，我们关注 60 到 70 个席位，几乎所有这些席位目前都由共和党人把持，在这一点上，胜负确实难以预料。

sentences.en: Democrats need to pick up 23 seats in order to take the majority.
sentences.zh: 民主党需要赢得 23 个席位才能获得多数席位。

sentences.en: The focus there is overwhelmingly Republicans on defense.
sentences.zh: 那里的焦点绝大多数是共和党的防守战。

sentences.en: Got it.

sentences.en: The Senate is almost the opposite picture.
sentences.zh: 参议院的情况几乎正好相反。

sentences.en: We have about half a dozen Senate races in states that are currently represented by Democrats where Republicans are on offense, trying to strengthen their majority.
sentences.zh: 我们有大约六场参议院选战发生在目前由民主党代表的州，共和党正在进攻，试图巩固他们的多数优势。

sentences.en: Republicans are defending a couple seats in places like Arizona and Nevada, but overall, the Senate is about Democrats on defense.
sentences.zh: 共和党在亚利桑那州和内华达州等地也在防守几个席位，但总体而言，参议院的选战主要是民主党的防守战。

sentences.en: So given how many races you're watching, Alex, how are you keeping track of all of this in your head?
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯，鉴于你关注的选战如此之多，你是如何在脑海中理清所有这些信息的？

sentences.en: and in different parts of the country.
sentences.zh: 以及在全国不同地区产生共鸣的主题。

sentences.en: I think you could probably boil it down to four big themes.
